notes.title: DarkSwitch is coming to the PC Gaming Show 2025!
notes.content:
[h3]We’re now ready to announce that DarkSwitch will be featured during this year’s [b]PC Gaming Show 2025[/b], one of the most prestigious showcases for upcoming PC titles! 
 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45607128/085f11bf864d48691532b3eaf0eccd12766558b2.png"][/img][/h3][p]🗓️ [b]Mark your calendars and set your alarms![/b]
📺 Watch it live here: 
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YXC7hf6PBTE"][/dynamiclink]This is a significant moment for our entire team at [b]Cyber Temple Games[/b] and for everyone who has been following the development of Dark Switch. We’ll be unveiling [b]exclusive, specially crafted [/b]for the show content — a first-ever glimpse at something [i]very[/i] special we’ve been keeping under wraps.[/p][p]Whether you're here for the [b]vertical city-building[/b], the [b]moral narrative choices[/b], or the thrill of [b]exploring the dreadful fog,[/b] be with us and watch the PC Gaming Show stream![/p][p]—
[b]Follow us[/b], [b]wishlist the game[/b], and stay tuned — we’re just getting started!
Join our Discord for more news: [url="https://discord.gg/SaF7VUZfNN"]https://discord.gg/SaF7VUZfNN[/url]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45607128/e6bbc5a8a4aa9e39ad96899e3092a6f63ae67779.png"][/img][/p]
